title: Quarterly stakeholder engagement brief — targeted asks & contingency lanes
creator: Ava Chen
description: Prepare a concise stakeholder-facing packet that synthesizes initiative health, OKR progress, near-term risks, and 3 prioritized executive decision asks. Purpose: enable a 20-minute leadership review with clear accept/decline lanes and contingency plans. Deliverables: one-pager summary, 12-slide exec deck, risk heatmap, ask decision matrix, and an action tracker. This will be used for the monthly exec sync and as the input to board Q&A if escalated.
acceptance_criteria: 1) One-page summary that makes the top-3 asks and impacts explicit; 2) Slide deck with metrics and run-rate charts validated against growth and cost dashboards; 3) Risk heatmap with mitigation owners assigned; 4) Decision matrix listing required approvals and tie-breaker owner; 5) Action tracker created and linked to Linear tickets for each follow-up.
activity: 2025-02-14 — Ava Chen: Kickoff created. Aligned with GTM and Eng leads to collect initiative health. Asked Analytics to surface rolling 8-week OKR trendlines.
2025-02-18 — Rohit Patel: Draft one-pager created (drive link in attachments). Suggested prioritizing asks around Dedicated capacity pricing and two SRE hires for runtime reliability.
2025-02-21 — Maya Singh (Analytics): Delivered metric pulls for latency, error rate, and per-token cost by model family. Noted spike in p99 latency for long-context bursts.
2025-02-25 — Design review: Provided two compact layouts for slide deck to emphasize decision lanes and trade-offs. Design asked for a visual risk heatmap and clear owners column.
2025-02-28 — Engineering sync: Confirmed feasibility of soft-capacity throttle and fallback policy before the exec meeting. ENG-4123 will deliver a runbook draft by 2025-03-06.
2025-03-02 — Rohit Patel: Incorporated analytics feedback; updated asks to include a pilot for user-segmented caching to reduce unit-cost. Deck is at 80%.
2025-03-03 — Ava Chen: Added contingency lanes for three scenarios (best-case, constrained-capacity, budget-cut) and set ask escalation path. Set dry-run for 2025-03-07.
2025-03-03 — Assigned actions: PM to schedule dry-run; Eng to finalize runbook; Legal to verify contract language for Dedicated pricing pilot.
comments: Marta Ruiz (VP Product): The asks look reasonable; please quantify impact of pilot to revenue and NRR. Add expected timeline for measurable signal (metric and date).
Jonas Becker (Head of Sales): Need a customer-facing FAQ if we pilot pricing changes. Suggest including a proposed comms plan slide.
Lina Park (Finance): If Dedicated pilot requires a refundable commitment, include expected ARR uplift and burn runway impact in the one-pager.
Rohit Patel: Noted — adding comms slide and ARR estimates. Will loop Finance for final numbers by 2025-03-05.
decision_log: 2025-02-25: Decided to limit asks to three items to keep the exec slot focused. (Owners: Ava Chen / Rohit Patel).
2025-03-01: Agreed to include a contingency lane for a 10% budget reduction. (Owner: Finance - Lina Park).
risks: Runway risk if Dedicated pilot discounts materialize without contract guardrails.
Operational risk: p99 latency regressions during long-context workloads could increase support load and slow adoption.
Stakeholder risk: insufficient comms to enterprise customers could lead to confusion during pilot.
next_steps: 2025-03-05: Finalize ARR and comms slide (Rohit + Finance).
2025-03-06: Engineering runbook and fallback validation complete (ENG-4123).
2025-03-07: Dry-run presentation with leadership and revised deck (Ava leads).
2025-03-10: Submit final packet for exec distribution and board readiness (deliverable due date).
